verses.original: אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן אִיּוֹב֙ אֶת־ פָּתַ֤ח פִּ֔יהוּ וַיְקַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ יוֹמֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên ’î·yō·wḇ ’eṯ- pā·ṯaḥ pî·hū way·qal·lêl ’eṯ- yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: After this Job - opened his mouth and cursed - the day of his [birth]

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: And [this is what] [he] said

verses.original: י֭וֹם אִוָּ֣לֶד בּ֑וֹ יֹ֣אבַד וְהַלַּ֥יְלָה אָ֝מַ֗ר גָֽבֶר׃ הֹ֣רָה
verses.transliteration: yō·wm ’iw·wā·leḏ bōw yō·ḇaḏ wə·hal·lay·lāh ’ā·mar ḡā·ḇer hō·rāh
verses.literal: May the day of my birth perish and the night it was said A boy is conceived

verses.original: הַה֗וּא הַיּ֥וֹם יְֽהִ֫י חֹ֥שֶׁךְ אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְאַל־ אַֽל־ יִדְרְשֵׁ֣הוּ נְהָרָֽה׃ תּוֹפַ֖ע עָלָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ha·hū hay·yō·wm yə·hî ḥō·šeḵ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mim·mā·‘al wə·’al- ’al- yiḏ·rə·šê·hū nə·hā·rāh tō·w·p̄a‘ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: If only that day had turned to darkness May God above . . . vvv disregard it [may no] light shine upon it

verses.original: חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ֭צַלְמָוֶת יִגְאָלֻ֡הוּ עֲנָנָ֑ה תִּשְׁכָּן־ עָלָ֣יו כִּֽמְרִ֥ירֵי יֽוֹם׃ יְ֝בַעֲתֻ֗הוּ
verses.transliteration: ḥō·šeḵ wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ yiḡ·’ā·lu·hū ‘ă·nā·nāh tiš·kān- ‘ā·lāw kim·rî·rê yō·wm yə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯu·hū
verses.literal: May darkness and gloom reclaim it and a cloud settle over it may the blackness of the day overwhelm it

verses.original: אֹ֥פֶל הַהוּא֮ הַלַּ֥יְלָה יִקָּחֵ֪ה֫וּ אַל־ יִ֭חַדְּ בִּימֵ֣י שָׁנָ֑ה אַל־ יָבֹֽא׃ בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר יְ֝רָחִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’ō·p̄el ha·hū hal·lay·lāh yiq·qā·ḥê·hū ’al- yi·ḥad bî·mê šā·nāh ’al- yā·ḇō bə·mis·par yə·rā·ḥîm
verses.literal: If only darkness had taken that night away May it not appear among the days of the year may it never be entered in any of the months

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הַ֭הוּא הַלַּ֣יְלָה יְהִ֣י גַלְמ֑וּד אַל־ רְנָנָ֣ה תָּבֹ֖א בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ha·hū hal·lay·lāh yə·hî ḡal·mūḏ ’al- rə·nā·nāh tā·ḇō ḇōw
verses.literal: Behold may that night be barren may no joyful voice come into it

verses.original: אֹרְרֵי־ יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ י֑וֹם הָ֝עֲתִידִ֗ים עֹרֵ֥ר לִוְיָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·rə·rê- yiq·qə·ḇu·hū yō·wm hā·‘ă·ṯî·ḏîm ‘ō·rêr liw·yā·ṯān
verses.literal: May it be cursed by those who curse the day those prepared to rouse Leviathan

verses.original: נִ֫שְׁפּ֥וֹ כּוֹכְבֵ֪י יֶחְשְׁכוּ֮ יְקַו־ וָאַ֑יִן לְא֥וֹר וְאַל־ יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי־ שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.transliteration: niš·pōw kō·wḵ·ḇê yeḥ·šə·ḵū yə·qaw- wā·’a·yin lə·’ō·wr wə·’al- yir·’eh bə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pê- šā·ḥar
verses.literal: May its morning stars grow dark may it wait in vain for daylight may it not see the breaking of dawn

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א סָ֭גַר דַּלְתֵ֣י בִטְנִ֑י וַיַּסְתֵּ֥ר עָ֝מָ֗ל מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō sā·ḡar dal·ṯê ḇiṭ·nî way·yas·têr ‘ā·māl mê·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: For that night did not shut the doors of the womb to hide the sorrow from my eyes

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה לֹּ֣א אָמ֑וּת מֵרֶ֣חֶם וְאֶגְוָֽע׃ יָצָ֣אתִי מִבֶּ֖טֶן
verses.transliteration: lām·māh lō ’ā·mūṯ mê·re·ḥem wə·’eḡ·wā‘ yā·ṣā·ṯî mib·be·ṭen
verses.literal: Why vvv did I not perish at birth why did I not die as I came from the womb

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ בִרְכָּ֑יִם קִדְּמ֣וּנִי וּמַה־ שָּׁ֝דַ֗יִם כִּ֣י אִינָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ ḇir·kā·yim qid·də·mū·nî ū·ma·hō·šā- šā·d̲a·yim kî ’î·nāq
verses.literal: Why were there knees to receive me [and] breasts that I should be nursed

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַ֭תָּה שָׁכַ֣בְתִּי וְאֶשְׁק֑וֹט יָ֝שַׁ֗נְתִּי אָ֤ז׀ יָנ֬וּחַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh šā·ḵaḇ·tî wə·’eš·qō·wṭ yā·šan·tî ’āz yā·nū·aḥ lî
verses.literal: For now I would be lying down in peace I would be asleep and at rest

verses.original: עִם־ מְ֭לָכִים וְיֹ֣עֲצֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַבֹּנִ֖ים לָֽמוֹ׃ חֳרָב֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘im- mə·lā·ḵîm wə·yō·‘ă·ṣê ’ā·reṣ hab·bō·nîm lā·mōw ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: with kings and counselors of the earth who built for themselves cities now in ruins

verses.original: א֣וֹ עִם־ שָׂ֭רִים זָהָ֣ב לָהֶ֑ם הַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ‘i·m·śā- śā·rîm zā·hāḇ lā·hem ham·mal·’îm bāt·tê·hem kā·sep̄
verses.literal: or with princes who had gold . . . who filled their houses with silver

verses.original: א֤וֹ אֶהְיֶ֑ה לֹ֣א טָ֭מוּן כְנֵ֣פֶל כְּ֝עֹלְלִ֗ים לֹא־ רָ֥אוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ’eh·yeh lō ṭā·mūn ḵə·nê·p̄el kə·‘ō·lə·lîm lō- rā·’ū ’ō·wr
verses.literal: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child like an infant who never sees daylight

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם רְ֭שָׁעִים חָ֣דְלוּ רֹ֑גֶז וְשָׁ֥ם יְגִ֣יעֵי כֹֽחַ׃ יָ֝נ֗וּחוּ
verses.transliteration: šām rə·šā·‘îm ḥā·ḏə·lū rō·ḡez wə·šām yə·ḡî·‘ê ḵō·aḥ yā·nū·ḥū
verses.literal: There the wicked cease from raging and there the weary . . . find rest

verses.original: אֲסִירִ֣ים יַ֭חַד שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ ק֣וֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·sî·rîm ya·ḥaḏ ša·’ă·nā·nū lō šā·mə·ʿû qō·wl nō·ḡêś
verses.literal: The captives enjoy their ease they do not hear the voice of the oppressor

verses.original: קָטֹ֣ן וְ֭גָדוֹל שָׁ֣ם ה֑וּא וְ֝עֶ֗בֶד חָפְשִׁ֥י מֵאֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: qā·ṭōn wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl šām hū wə·‘e·ḇeḏ ḥā·p̄ə·šî mê·’ă·ḏō·nāw
verses.literal: Both small and great are there . . . and the slave is freed from his master

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה א֑וֹר יִתֵּ֣ן לְעָמֵ֣ל וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ’ō·wr yit·tên lə·‘ā·mêl wə·ḥay·yîm lə·mā·rê nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Why is light given to the miserable and life to the bitter of soul

verses.original: הַֽמְחַכִּ֣ים לַמָּ֣וֶת וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וַֽ֝יַּחְפְּרֻ֗הוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ham·ḥak·kîm lam·mā·weṯ wə·’ê·nen·nū way·yaḥ·pə·ru·hū mim·maṭ·mō·w·nîm
verses.literal: who long for death that does not come and search for it like hidden treasure

verses.original: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֥ים אֱלֵי־ גִ֑יל יָ֝שִׂ֗ישׂוּ כִּ֣י יִמְצְאוּ־ קָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śə·mê·ḥîm ’ĕ·lê- ḡîl yā·śî·śū kî yim·ṣə·’ū- qā·ḇer
verses.literal: who rejoice . . . and greatly exult when they reach the grave

verses.original: לְ֭גֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר־ דַּרְכּ֣וֹ נִסְתָּ֑רָה אֱל֣וֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽוֹ׃ וַיָּ֖סֶךְ
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡe·ḇer ’ă·šer- dar·kōw nis·tā·rāh ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ba·‘ă·ḏōw way·yā·seḵ
verses.literal: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden whom God . . . has hedged in

verses.original: אַנְחָתִ֣י כִּֽי־ לַ֭חְמִי תָבֹ֑א לִפְנֵ֣י שַׁאֲגֹתָֽי׃ וַֽיִּתְּכ֥וּ כַ֝מַּ֗יִם
verses.transliteration: ’an·ḥā·ṯî kî- laḥ·mî ṯā·ḇō lip̄·nê ša·’ă·ḡō·ṯāy way·yit·tə·ḵū ḵam·ma·yim
verses.literal: I sigh when food is put before me and my groans pour out like water

verses.original: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד פָּ֭חַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵ֑נִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝גֹ֗רְתִּי יָ֣בֹא לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî p̄a·ḥaḏ pā·ḥaḏ·tî way·ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yê·nî wa·’ă·šer yā·ḡō·rə·tî yā·ḇō lî
verses.literal: For the thing I feared has overtaken me and what I dreaded has befallen me

verses.original: לֹ֤א שָׁלַ֨וְתִּי׀ שָׁקַ֥טְתִּי וְֽלֹא־ וְלֹ֖א נָ֗חְתִּי רֹֽגֶז׃פ וַיָּ֥בֹא
verses.transliteration: lō šā·law·tî šā·qaṭ·tî wə·lō- wə·lō nā·ḥə·tî rō·ḡez way·yā·ḇō
verses.literal: I am not at ease or quiet . . . I have no rest for trouble has come
